caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object resembling an ornate shield or plaque. The object has a rich brown color with visible grain patterns indicative of carved wood. Its outline is highly decorative, featuring elaborate, symmetrical leaf-like extensions on the top and side edges. At the center of the object, within the main shield-shaped area, there is a carved relief of a bird in flight holding an olive branch in its beak. The carving of the bird is detailed, showing individual feathers and the extended wings. The top of the plaque has a central hole, possibly for hanging, and the background of the drawing is plain off-white without other objects or elements.
title: Wall Rack for Newspapers
